description.en: The description of the firewall template.

description.zh:
端口范围。端口的取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，例如：`1024/1055`表示端口范围为1024~1055。

> 如果您设置的是ICMP协议，端口只能为-1/-1。
description.en:
The port range. The valid range is 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port from the end port. For example, `1024/1055` indicates a port range from 1024 to 1055.

> If you set the protocol to ICMP, you must set the port range to -1/-1.
The remarks for the firewall rule.

description.zh:
传输层协议。可能值：

- TCP：TCP协议。
- UDP：UDP协议。
- TCP+UDP：TCP和UDP协议。
- ICMP：ICMP协议。
description.en:
The transport-layer protocol. Valid values:

- TCP: TCP.

- UDP: UDP.

- TCP+UDP: TCP and UDP.

- ICMP: ICMP.

description.zh: 需要设置访问权限的源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。
description.en: The source IPv4 CIDR block to which you want to grant access. Both CIDR notation and IPv4 addresses are supported.
The name of the firewall template.

description.zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查看支持的阿里云地域列表。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Simple Application Server instance is located.
You can call [ListRegions](~~189315~~) to view a list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions.

descriptions.zh: 防火墙模板提供了一种可以包含多条防火墙规则的模板功能，您可以通过模板同时向一个或多个实例中添加一组防火墙规则，提高设置防火墙规则的效率。
descriptions.en: A firewall template can contain multiple firewall rules. You can use a template to apply a set of firewall rules to one or more instances simultaneously. This helps you set firewall rules more efficiently.
